row.notes: The mode-0 session tag check of a 0x6c-byte tyre set record (rcx = set, returns al, 1 usable): flags +9 & 9 (damaged / handed back) refuse; g_Sess_TyreRulesActive 0 or tag +0x00 == 0 allow; in practice 1-4 a tag 1-4 is allowed; in qualifying 5-9 a tag 5-9 is allowed (tag 7 with flag bit2 only up to session 6); in races 15-17 a tag 5..14 (qualifying / shootout), the race's own tag or a race tag without flag bit2 is allowed.
